Title: Post composer displays required controls
Preconditions: Logged in as demo Admin-role user; on Buzz Newsfeed page (/web/index.php/buzz/viewBuzz) - per PRD FR-016 and Exploration §3.2.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to the Buzz Newsfeed page. 2. Observe the post composer region at the top of the feed.
Expected Result: Composer displays a 'What's on your mind?' textbox, a 'Post' button, a 'Share Photos' button, and a 'Share Video' button. Structural presence only; typing/publishing behavior not exercised (see BUZZ-TC-021, requires live confirmation).

Title: Feed post card displays author, timestamp, content, and counters
Preconditions: Logged in as demo Admin-role user; feed contains existing demo posts - per PRD FR-017; Exploration §3.1, §3.6-3.9.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to the Buzz Newsfeed page. 2. Inspect each post card in the feed.
Test Data: Existing demo feed (4 posts observed: manda akhil user, Sania Shaheen, Rebecca Harmony, Russel Hamilton) - snapshot-specific per Exploration §5 item 9; names/counts may differ on later runs.
Expected Result: Each post card displays author name, avatar, timestamp, text content and/or image, and Like/Comment/Share counters (e.g. '0 Likes', '1 Like', '0 Comments', '0 Shares').

Title: Default feed filter is 'Most Recent Posts'
Preconditions: On Buzz Newsfeed page; feed has not been re-sorted this session - per Exploration §3.5.
Test Steps: 1. Load the Buzz Newsfeed page. 2. Observe which filter button carries the active state and the resulting post order.
Expected Result: 'Most Recent Posts' is the default active filter; posts appear in reverse-chronological order by timestamp.

Title: 'Most Liked Posts' filter sorts descending by Like count
Preconditions: On Buzz Newsfeed page, default 'Most Recent Posts' view active - per PRD FR-018; Exploration §3.5.
Test Steps: 1. Click the 'Most Liked Posts' filter button. 2. Observe the resulting post order and the button's active state.
Expected Result: Feed re-sorts posts in descending order by Like count; the 'Most Liked Posts' button gains the active state.

Title: 'Most Recent Posts' restores original feed order
Preconditions: 'Most Liked Posts' or 'Most Commented Posts' filter currently active - per Exploration §3.5.
Test Steps: 1. Click 'Most Recent Posts' after a different filter has been applied. 2. Compare the resulting order to the original default order.
Expected Result: Feed order is restored exactly to the original reverse-chronological order; no underlying post data is altered by re-sorting - confirms filter switching is fully reversible/non-destructive.

Title: Upcoming Anniversaries panel displays and is non-interactive
Preconditions: On Buzz Newsfeed page - per PRD FR-019; Exploration §3.13.
Test Steps: 1. Observe the 'Upcoming Anniversaries' panel on the right side of the page. 2. Click the anniversary entry.
Expected Result: Panel displays employee avatar, name, job title, a year-count badge, and a date; clicking the entry produces no navigation or visible effect (static/display-only).

Title: 'Read More' expands truncated post text
Preconditions: A post with truncated (long) text is present in the feed (e.g. Sania Shaheen's post) - per PRD §6 (Module: Buzz); Exploration §3.6.
Test Steps: 1. Locate a post showing a 'Read More' link below truncated text. 2. Click 'Read More'.
Expected Result: The post's full text becomes visible and the 'Read More' link disappears; no collapse/'Show Less' control appears afterward (expansion is one-directional - a detail the PRD did not state).

Title: Like/Unlike toggle updates count and icon state
Preconditions: A post with a known Like count (e.g. 0 Likes) is present - per Exploration §3.7.
Test Steps: 1. Click the heart icon on a post showing '0 Likes'. 2. Observe the count and icon state. 3. Click the same heart icon again. 4. Observe the count and icon state.
Expected Result: After step 1: count becomes '1 Like', heart icon turns solid red (liked state). After step 3: count returns to '0 Likes', icon returns to grey/outline (unliked state). Note: the Like icon has no accessible name and uses a duplicated id="heart-svg" across posts - an automation-readiness concern, not a functional defect (see Exploration §4 Locator Reference Table).

Title: Comment toggle expands/collapses inline comment box
Preconditions: A post showing '0 Comments' is present - per Exploration §3.8.
Test Steps: 1. Click the '0 Comments' text/icon on a post. 2. Observe the comment area. 3. Click '0 Comments' again.
Expected Result: Step 1 expands an inline 'Write your comment...' textbox beneath the post's action row, with no page navigation. Step 3 collapses the textbox again with no visible side effects. No text was typed/submitted; see BUZZ-TC-025 (requires live confirmation) for the comment-submission case.

Title: Options menu on own post shows Edit Post and Delete Post
Preconditions: Logged in as the demo Admin-role account; the feed contains a post authored by the logged-in user (matched by avatar/display name) - per PRD BR-005; Exploration §3.9.
Test Steps: 1. Locate the logged-in user's own post in the feed. 2. Click the '...' options icon on that post. 3. Observe the menu items shown.
Expected Result: Menu shows exactly two items: 'Edit Post' and 'Delete Post'. This is the first direct evidence resolving BR-005 (previously entirely Unknown / Not observed in the PRD). Neither menu item was clicked.

Title: Options menu on another author's post shows Delete Post only
Preconditions: Logged in as the demo Admin-role account; the feed contains at least one post authored by a different user (e.g. Sania Shaheen, Rebecca Harmony) - per PRD BR-005; Exploration §3.9.
Test Steps: 1. Locate a post authored by a different user. 2. Click the '...' options icon on that post. 3. Observe the menu items shown.
Expected Result: Menu shows exactly one item: 'Delete Post' (no 'Edit Post' option). Permission/role case confirming the Admin-role account can delete any post but only edit its own, at the UI level. Whether this is also enforced server-side is unconfirmed - see BUZZ-TC-027 (requires live confirmation).

Title: Share Photos 'Share' button disabled until photo attached
Preconditions: On Buzz Newsfeed page - per Exploration §3.3.
Test Steps: 1. Click the 'Share Photos' button in the composer. 2. Without attaching a photo, observe the 'Share' button's state.
Expected Result: 'Share' button is disabled while no photo is attached. Contrast with BUZZ-TC-019, where the equivalent Share Video flow does not disable Share under an empty-input condition.

Title: Clicking attached photo opens full-screen lightbox
Preconditions: A post with an attached photo is present in the feed (e.g. Rebecca Harmony's post) - per Exploration §3.11 (not documented in PRD Section 6; new finding).
Test Steps: 1. Click the attached photo on a post. 2. Observe the resulting view. 3. Close via the 'x' button.
Expected Result: A full-screen lightbox opens showing the image enlarged alongside an independent post-detail panel (author, timestamp, caption, its own Like/Comment/Share row). Closing returns cleanly to the feed with no residual state change.

Title: Share Post (repost) modal opens with optional caption
Preconditions: On Buzz Newsfeed page; at least one post exists in the feed - per Exploration §3.10.
Test Steps: 1. Click the Share (repost) icon on a post's action row. 2. Observe the resulting dialog and the 'Share' button's state without entering a caption.
Expected Result: A 'Share Post' dialog opens with a read-only preview of the original post and an optional caption textbox; the 'Share' button is enabled even with no caption entered. Caption appears intentionally optional (unlike Share Video's URL field); not flagged as a validation discrepancy in Exploration §5, unlike BUZZ-TC-019.

Title: Post author name/avatar click produces no navigation
Preconditions: On Buzz Newsfeed page - per Exploration §3.12.
Test Steps: 1. Click a post author's displayed name. 2. Observe the URL/page. 3. Click the same author's avatar image. 4. Observe the URL/page.
Expected Result: Neither click navigates away or produces a visible effect; the URL remains /web/index.php/buzz/viewBuzz throughout (no profile drill-through from the Buzz feed).

Title: Topbar 'Help' button opens external site in new tab
Preconditions: On Buzz Newsfeed page - per Exploration §3.14; Reconciliation §5 discrepancy 1.
Test Steps: 1. Click the single icon in the Buzz Topbar Menu region (labeled with title='Help'). 2. Observe the resulting browser behavior.
Expected Result: A new browser tab opens to the external URL https://starterhelp.orangehrm.com/hc/en-us; the icon is not a collapse/hamburger navigation control. Corrects PRD Section 5, which described this icon as a 'collapse/hamburger control'.

Title: Profile menu shows About/Support/Change Password/Logout on Buzz page
Preconditions: On Buzz Newsfeed page - per PRD FR-020; Exploration §3.15 (global control re-verified specifically on the Buzz page).
Test Steps: 1. Click the logged-in user's profile name in the top banner. 2. Observe the menu items.
Expected Result: Menu shows 'About', 'Support', 'Change Password', and 'Logout' items. No item was selected.

Title: Feed displays all posts with no pagination at current volume
Preconditions: On Buzz Newsfeed page with the current demo data volume (4 posts observed) - per Exploration §3.1.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to the Buzz Newsfeed page. 2. Scroll to the bottom of the feed. 3. Observe whether the page footer appears immediately after the last post.
Expected Result: All posts are shown without pagination controls or infinite-scroll loading; the page footer appears immediately after the last (4th) post. Only verified at the current data volume; behavior at higher post counts is unconfirmed (Exploration §7 Open Question 5).

Title: Share Video 'Share' button not disabled despite empty Video URL (defect candidate)
Preconditions: On Buzz Newsfeed page - per Exploration §3.4; Reconciliation §5 discrepancy 2.
Test Steps: 1. Click the 'Share Video' button in the composer. 2. Leave the 'Paste Video URL' field empty. 3. Observe the 'Share' button's state.
Expected Result: DEFECT CANDIDATE: 'Share' button remains enabled/clickable despite the Video URL field being empty, unlike the equivalent Share Photos flow (BUZZ-TC-012), where Share is disabled with no photo attached. Flag for QC review as a validation asymmetry. The button was not clicked, so whether submission actually succeeds/fails with an empty URL is unconfirmed - see BUZZ-TC-024 (requires live confirmation).

Title: 'Most Liked' vs 'Most Commented' tie-break order differs
Preconditions: All posts in the feed currently have 0 Comments (as observed); Like counts vary - per Exploration §3.5; Reconciliation §5 discrepancy 7.
Test Steps: 1. Click 'Most Liked Posts' and record the resulting order among posts tied on other attributes. 2. Click 'Most Commented Posts' and record the resulting order among the (all-zero-comment) posts. 3. Compare the two tie-break orders.
Test Data: 4-post demo feed: manda akhil user (0 Likes), Sania Shaheen (1 Like), Rebecca Harmony (0 Likes), Russel Hamilton (2 Likes) - all with 0 Comments. Snapshot-specific per Exploration §5 item 9.
Expected Result: The two filters order same-count posts differently from each other (e.g. 'Most Liked Posts' places Sania before Rebecca; 'Most Commented Posts' places Rebecca before Sania), indicating independent secondary sort keys rather than a shared stable sort. Underlying secondary sort key not determinable from black-box observation (Exploration §7 Open Question 4).

Title: Verify server-side enforcement of Edit Post permission (requires live confirmation)
Preconditions: A disposable/sandboxed instance, or API-level access, authorized for edit actions on another user's record - per Exploration §6 Excluded Actions row 6; Exploration §7 Open Question 1.
Test Steps: 1. As the logged-in Admin-role account, attempt to edit a post authored by a different user (e.g. via a direct API/form call, since the UI does not expose 'Edit Post' for other users' posts per BUZZ-TC-011). 2. Observe whether the server accepts or rejects the edit.
Test Data: N/A - requires a sanctioned edit-flow test or code/API review.
Expected Result: Requires live confirmation - not exercised this run. Whether 'Edit Post' visibility is a client-side-only UI check or a server-enforced permission is unconfirmed. Directly follows from BUZZ-TC-010/BUZZ-TC-011's confirmed UI-level pattern; this case probes whether that pattern is also enforced server-side - an authorization/security-relevant gap, not yet a confirmed vulnerability.
